vendors.name: MCP Inspector
checklist: Create a dashboard-managed public PKCE MCP client.
Complete the hosted OAuth consent and callback flow from MCP Inspector.
Call remember, recall, profile, and forget with the bearer token.

evidence.notes: MCP Inspector CLI ran against the hosted production /mcp endpoint using a dashboard-managed public PKCE client with the Inspector loopback callback URL. It listed tools, resources, and prompts, called remember, recall, profile, and forget, read openmemory://profile and openmemory://recent, fetched the context prompt, then cleaned up the throwaway hosted account.

vendors.notes: Passed real MCP Inspector CLI dogfooding against the deployed Worker.
